# hpe_morpheus_user_source (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Identity Source (User Source) resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_user_source" "example" {
  name       = "Example User Source"
  type       = "ldap"
  account_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) The account (tenant) ID to create the identity source under.
- `name` (String) The name of the identity source.
- `type` (String) The type code of the identity source (e.g. ldap, saml, activeDirectory).

### Optional

- `default_account_role_id` (Number) The ID of the default account role.
- `description` (String) The description of the identity source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the identity source.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_user_source.example 123
```
